PublicDescription: Counts the total number of decode penalties.  This includes but is not limited to penalties associated with PREDECODE_WRONG, MS_DECODED.MS_ENTRY, >4 prefix/escape bytes on an instruction, or too many branches at the same time.   The processor can accommodate most, but not all cases of 2-branch-per-cycle without penalty.
